svg.title: Dashboard wireframe
svg.text: First run: onboarding, then the empty plan state.
A plan projects your money year by year.
Collects your own birth date, state, and currency.
Pick a persona. Lands on a populated dashboard.
Sandbox data is labeled and excluded from paid runs.
KPI row reads the profile and finances from Postgres, not from client state. Reload restores the same values.
Empty state is explicit: 'No plans yet' plus one New plan action. No invented numbers.
Normal walkthrough collects individual/couple, birth month and year, US state, and currency before the dashboard.
Sandbox selects a persona (for example Recent Grad, Single) and lands on a populated dashboard without personal
